mp4-muxer 5.1.3 / npm (MIT, Copyright (c) 2023 Vanilagy)
Official source: https://github.com/Vanilagy/mp4-muxer
Module: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mp4-muxer@5.1.3/build/mp4-muxer.mjs  (license: mp4-muxer.LICENSE.txt)
Downloaded 2026-11-05, content unmodified. Used only to wrap WebCodecs H.264 chunks into MP4; no network calls.


Three.js r160 addons (MIT, same copyright as three.js): examples/jsm/loaders/FBXLoader.js, examples/jsm/curves/NURBSCurve.js, examples/jsm/curves/NURBSUtils.js, examples/jsm/exporters/GLTFExporter.js, examples/jsm/utils/TextureUtils.js, examples/jsm/controls/TransformControls.js (GLTFExporter + TextureUtils + TransformControls downloaded 2026-11-06)
fflate (MIT, Copyright (c) 2023 Arjun Barrett): examples/jsm/libs/fflate.module.js (as bundled with three.js r160)
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/  — downloaded 2026-11-06, content unmodified, kept under vendor/addons/ with the original relative layout.
The addons import the bare specifier 'three', which index.html maps to ./vendor/three.module.js with an import map. FBXLoader is loaded only when scene.json lists motions. TransformControls provides the move / rotate / scale handles of the in-page editor (editor.js). GLTFExporter is loaded only when 导出 Blender is clicked; it runs entirely in the page and makes no network calls.
Runtime requests are limited to local app.js, editor.js, viewtools.js, weather.js, styles.css, scene.json, the vendor modules above, and the .fbx files that scene.json lists.

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/tasks-vision@0.10.35/ — downloaded 2026-11-07, content unmodified, kept under vendor/mediapipe/.

Source: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/pose_landmarker/pose_landmarker_full/float16/latest/pose_landmarker_full.task — downloaded 2026-11-07.
Pose model (optional「精细识别」): pose_landmarker_heavy.task (MediaPipe Pose Landmarker "heavy", float16, Apache-2.0, 30664242 bytes, sha256 64437af838a65d18e5ba7a0d39b465540069bc8aae8308de3e318aad31fcbc7b)
Source: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/pose_landmarker/pose_landmarker_heavy/float16/latest/pose_landmarker_heavy.task — downloaded 2026-11-07.
Used only by 视频动捕 (videomocap.js), loaded when that dialog is opened; the video is processed entirely in the page and never uploaded.
